All new graduate students are strongly encouraged to attend.

● Venue: Seoul National University, Building 301, Room 102
● Who should attend: New graduate students for the 2nd semester of 2026 (students admitted in September 2026)
● Contact: Department Administration Office (학부행정실), Building 301, Room 319 / 박한수 (Park Han-su) / hansoopark@snu.ac.kr
